Belarus
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Moscow, Russia.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Beograd
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Republic of Belarus are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina. Visa shall be issued in Moskva, Russia.
